embeds.title: 🔴 Hackers Bypass SonicWall VPN MFA Due to Incomplete Patching
embeds.description:
ReliaQuest researchers assessed with medium confidence the first in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2024-12802 targeting SonicWall Gen6 SSL-VPN devices across multiple environments between February and March. Threat actors brute-forced VPN credentials and bypassed MFA on incompletely patched devices to gain initial access, reaching internal networks and attempting to deploy Cobalt Strike beacons and vulnerable drivers. The researchers believe the threat actor is a broker selling initial access to threat groups.
